description: This file defines a PHP class that serves as a client for interacting with the AWS Serverless Application Repository service. It includes method signatures for various API calls related to applications, such as creating, listing, and updating applications and their versions, as well as managing policies and CloudFormation templates.

classes.name: ServerlessApplicationRepositoryClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Serverless Application Repository service, extending the generic AwsClient to include specific methods for application management.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application in the AWS Serverless Application Repository.

methods.name: createApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new application, returning a Promise.

methods.name: createApplicationVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing application.

methods.name: createApplicationVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new application version, returning a Promise.

methods.name: createCloudFormationChangeSet
methods.description: Creates a CloudFormation change set for an application.

methods.name: createCloudFormationChangeSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a CloudFormation change set, returning a Promise.

methods.name: createCloudFormationTemplate
methods.description: Generates a CloudFormation template for an application.

methods.name: createCloudFormationTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a CloudFormation template, returning a Promise.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes an application from the repository.

methods.name: deleteApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an application, returning a Promise.

methods.name: getApplication
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific application.

methods.name: getApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves application information, returning a Promise.

methods.name: getApplicationPolicy
methods.description: Gets the access policy associated with an application.

methods.name: getApplicationPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the application policy, returning a Promise.

methods.name: getCloudFormationTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the CloudFormation template for an application.

methods.name: getCloudFormationTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the template, returning a Promise.

methods.name: listApplicationDependencies
methods.description: Lists dependencies of an application.

methods.name: listApplicationDependenciesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists dependencies, returning a Promise.

methods.name: listApplicationVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of an application.

methods.name: listApplicationVersionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists application versions, returning a Promise.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all applications.

methods.name: listApplicationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists applications, returning a Promise.

methods.name: putApplicationPolicy
methods.description: Sets or updates the access policy for an application.

methods.name: putApplicationPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets or updates the application policy, returning a Promise.

methods.name: unshareApplication
methods.description: Unshares an application from another account or organization.

methods.name: unshareApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unshares an application, returning a Promise.

methods.name: updateApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing application.

methods.name: updateApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an application, returning a Promise.
